title: Position Thyself
story: There is a program at /challenge/ called run that hands out your first real flag. It’s picky about where you’re standing in the filesystem and how you call it. Listen to what it tells you.
description: Execute the program from /var/log using its absolute path.
hints: Listen to what the error message tells you when you run the program.
Check which directory you are standing in right now and move to /var/log.
Make sure you call the program using its full path starting with `/`, not `./run`.
